shortAnswerNote: Short answers are marked with an AI-written rubric: each answer must contain the key ideas (any accepted wording).
detailsDescription: Only a title and one source (prompt, resource, file or link) are required.
title: Title
promptHint: Describe the topic, level and anything the questions should focus on. Optional if you add material below.
sourceDescription: Learning objectives and questions are generated from the prompt and everything selected here.
noResources: No resources yet. Upload files below or from the Resources page.
filesHint: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, text or images, up to 20 MB each. Scans are read with OCR.
linksHint: Web pages are read and used as source material.
questionsDescription: Every student gets the same number of questions per learning objective, but different questions.
adaptiveDescription: Each student starts at medium difficulty; it goes up after strong answers and down after weak ones. Every student still covers the same objectives.
liveScoreDescription: Students see whether each answer was correct and their running score during the exam. Off by default.
negativeMarkingDescription: Wrong answers lose the deduction set in each question block. Turn off to never deduct marks.
negativeOffHint: Negative marking is off for this assessment
linksSkipped: These links could not be read and were not used: {{links}}
